$comment: OVS house style (north star: Chris Boustedt @chriss.boustedt). Scripts and compositions read this file; the canonical rules are in CLAUDE.md (EDIT WORKFLOW + HOUSE LOOK). If they disagree, update both.

length.$comment: Aim for 30-45s unless note.txt or the inline notes after `edit <folder>` say otherwise. If essential content can't fit, propose the cut or a split in the storyboard; never drop it silently.

hook.$comment: Hook in the first 2-3s: picture + words say the same thing; works muted.

cuts.$comment: Natural pacing: cut long silences, ums, false starts and repeated takes (keep the best/last complete take). Keep natural pauses so sentences finish. No jittery over-cutting, never retime or atempo the voice.
cuts.contextFillersRule: cut only where clearly filler; keep where they carry meaning

transitions.flash: avoid (one light flash on a hit only if Justin asks)

fonts.$comment: Headings target Druk Wide (not licensed yet). Swap heading.family once licensed; everything reads from here.

captions.chunking: one word or short phrase (max 3 words)
captions.$comment: Centred, Inter Bold or heavier (Inter Black 900 for BOLD), no drop shadow. Word captions follow speech; a caption group never spans a cut.

textBehindSubject.$comment: perVideo applies to BOLD. In CLEAN it is the main device; the storyboard decides where.

graphics.layered: hook text, word captions, UI cards, text-behind-subject: dense but tidy

fullScreenGraphic.brief: When the video says [exact line], show [what] full-screen, in brand colours/font, max 3 icons, one big headline, no small text, 2-3s, then cut back to the speaker.

deliveryChecklist: Storyboard approved by Justin before the render
Hook in the first 2-3s (picture = on-screen text = first spoken line)
Length 30-45s (or what the notes asked), never over 45s unless the notes say so
Something changes on screen at least every 2s
Natural pauses kept, sentences complete, voice at natural speed
Captions word-checked (incl. Mudex, One Vox Studio, Leederville), centred, inside the safe zone, no drop shadow
On-screen text changes only on a cut or photo change

drive.$comment: IDs verified with rclone on 2026-11-06. Transfers go through scripts/drive.sh. Drive folders + the `edit <folder name>` chat command are the whole interface.

inbox.name: 1 Drop Clips
inbox.deleteRaw: never by default; only when Justin explicitly says so

drive.ignoreJobsNote: IMG_0400 and DJ Headshots CANCELLED (2026-11-05); Driftability / Mudex: Driftability STOPPED. Never restart unless Justin explicitly asks.

music.policy: No licensed music yet: ship without music.

reference.$comment: Optional per video: a video file with 'ref' in its name and/or note.txt with a reel link + notes.
reference.precedence: Reference overrides house style only where it differs; everything it does not show stays house style. Build with HyperFrames catalog blocks.

clipRoles.$comment: A-roll = clips with speech; B-roll = clips without meaningful speech.

vibes.$comment: Pick from note.txt or the inline notes; otherwise ask Justin once. One style system: both vibes use the same restyled catalog blocks.
vibes.BOLD: Inter Black caps captions at y~1190, #FFD400 keyword blocks, chapter pills, text-behind-subject once per video.
vibes.CLEAN: Minimal captions; giant heading-face text masked behind the subject (Chris Boustedt) is the main device.

storyboard.stills: one per moment, text and graphics placed
storyboard.gate: wait for Justin's notes, apply them, then render

hyperframes.$comment: Pinned. Always run `npx -y hyperframes@0.8.185 ...` (bare `npx hyperframes` fetches the latest). No upgrade, Pro skills (reverse-any-video, style-sampling), template pulls, cloud render or publish unless Justin approves a separate trial.
